verses.english: Desire, Etc. for the Not-Self Exterior

verses.pali: “Yo, bhikkhave, anattā, tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up desire … greed … desire and greed for what is not-self.

verses.pali: Rūpā, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Sights, sounds, smells, tastes, touches, and ideas are not-self …”

verses.pali: dhammā anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
Yo, bhikkhave, anattā tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
